application.description: E-commerce channel: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) for sellers — listings, stock, price, orders, shipments, returns, reports, feeds and notifications. Tier-1 canonical services share one contract with flipkart_seller and shopify_admin (docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md); every other SP-API operation is a tier-2 pass-through service. LWA OAuth (refresh-token grant) with the token in x-amz-access-token; no SigV4.

client_id.label: LWA client ID
client_id.description: App client ID (Solution Provider Portal / Seller Central Develop Apps). Sandbox: the SANDBOX app client's ID.

client_secret.label: LWA client secret
client_secret.description: App client secret — rotate every 180 days.

refresh_token.label: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Seller refresh token (self-authorisation or OAuth). Sandbox: 'Create Token' on the sandbox app client. Leave empty ONLY for a grantless connection.

endpoint.label: SP-API endpoint
endpoint.description: Live India/EU: https://sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com | Sandbox India/EU: https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com | NA: https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com | FE: https://sellingpartnerapi-fe.amazon.com

seller_id.label: Seller ID (merchant token)
seller_id.description: Selling partner id used in Listings paths (Seller Central > Settings > Account Info > Merchant Token).

marketplace_id.label: Marketplace ID
marketplace_id.description: amazon.in = A21TJRUUN4KGV (static sandbox canned cases often use ATVPDKIKX0DER).

scope.label: Grantless scope
scope.description: Only for a grantless connection (no refresh_token), e.g. sellingpartnerapi::notifications.

services.description: CANONICAL tier-1 service (identical parameters/output on amazon_sp_api, flipkart_seller, shopify_admin; contract: docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md). Amazon SP-API: Listings Items 2021-08-01 putListingsItem (5 rps/burst 10). requirements=LISTING_OFFER_ONLY when channel_product_id (ASIN) is given, else LISTING (new ASIN, full attributes needed for the productType). status INACTIVE sends quantity 0 (Amazon has no inactive flag). attributes_json is merged over the generated attributes. Fails on status INVALID or an ERROR issue. Role: Product Listing.

events.description: Amazon ORDER_CHANGE (SQS): Sent on important order changes: order status changes (incl. new Pending/Unshipped orders), buyer-requested cancellation, delivery tip change. eventFilter orderChangeTypes…
Amazon LISTINGS_ITEM_STATUS_CHANGE (EventBridge): Listing created, deleted, or buyability changed.
Amazon LISTINGS_ITEM_ISSUES_CHANGE (EventBridge): Issues on a listing changed (suppression, inactive, quality).
Amazon LISTINGS_ITEM_MFN_QUANTITY_CHANGE (EventBridge): Available quantity of a seller-fulfilled (MFN) listing changed (e.g. after an order).
Amazon FBA_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY_CHANGES (SQS): FBA inventory quantities changed (snapshot across region stores).
Amazon ITEM_INVENTORY_EVENT_CHANGE (SQS): Hourly ASIN-level inventory availability changes (sellers and vendors).
Amazon ITEM_SALES_EVENT_CHANGE (SQS): Hourly ASIN-level ordered units / revenue.
Amazon DETAIL_PAGE_TRAFFIC_EVENT (SQS): Hourly ASIN-level glance views.
Amazon ANY_OFFER_CHANGED (SQS): Change in top-20 offers / Buy Box for an item the seller lists.
Amazon B2B_ANY_OFFER_CHANGED (SQS): Change in top-20 B2B offers incl. quantity tiers.
Amazon PRICING_HEALTH (SQS): Seller offer ineligible for Featured Offer due to uncompetitive price.
Amazon FEE_PROMOTION (SQS): Time-limited fee promotions available to the seller.
Amazon REPORT_PROCESSING_FINISHED (SQS): A requested report reached DONE / CANCELLED / FATAL.
Amazon FEED_PROCESSING_FINISHED (SQS): A submitted feed reached DONE / CANCELLED / FATAL.
Amazon DATA_KIOSK_QUERY_PROCESSING_FINISHED (SQS): A Data Kiosk query finished processing.
Amazon TRANSACTION_UPDATE (SQS): A new financial transaction was posted to the seller account.
Amazon FULFILLMENT_ORDER_STATUS (SQS): Status change of a Multi-Channel Fulfillment (FBA outbound) order.
Amazon FBA_OUTBOUND_SHIPMENT_STATUS (SQS): Amazon created/cancelled an FBA Onsite shipment (Brazil only).

Amazon EXTERNAL_FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_STATUS_CHANGE (SQS): Status change of a warehouse-integration (external fulfillment) shipment: ACCEPTED, CONFIRMED, PACKAGE_CREATED, PICKUP_SLOT_RETRIEVED, INVOIC…
Amazon SHIPMENT_TRACKING_MILESTONE_CHANGED (EventBridge): Tracking milestone changed for a subscribed tracking identifier (requires eventFilter trackingIdentifier).
Amazon ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED (SQS): Seller account status changed between NORMAL, AT_RISK, DEACTIVATED.
Amazon BRANDED_ITEM_CONTENT_CHANGE (EventBridge): Title/description/bullets/images changed on a brand-owned ASIN.
Amazon ITEM_PRODUCT_TYPE_CHANGE (EventBridge): Product type changed for a brand-owned ASIN.
Amazon PRODUCT_TYPE_DEFINITIONS_CHANGE (EventBridge): New product type or product type version published.
Amazon APPLICATION_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_EXPIRY (SQS): LWA client secret approaching expiry (registered in Developer Console > Notification Preferences, SQS only).
Amazon APPLICATION_OAUTH_CLIENT_NEW_SECRET (SQS): New LWA client secret delivered after rotateApplicationClientSecret (Notification Preferences > "New Secret" row, SQS).
